scope: Proposition 5 of the manuscript “A product counterexample to the simplex maximum for projection-body volume” (preprints/A-product-counterexample-to-the-simplex-maximum-for-projection-body-volume-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 088 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1d2211bb8d175f40), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For d ≥ 2, the standard simplex Td = conv(0, e1, . . . , ed) ⊂ Rd satisfies |Td| = 1 d! , |ΠTd| = d + 1 ((d − 1)!)d , Rd(Td) = cd. Every full-dimensional d-simplex has the same value cd.
